From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Subject: Acme POC results + quick ask: 15-min quote & short testimonial

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for running the POC with us last week. We’ve pulled together a short metrics packet (attached) that summarizes the outcomes across the three pilot flows we instrumented: checkout fraud scoring, personalized product copy, and search rerank. Highlights: 

- Median latency improved from 210ms to 85ms at 95th percentile when switching to our optimized serving profile.
- Token cost per inference reduced ~38% with prefix caching and lighter quantization profile on the search rerank path.
- End-to-end throughput doubled for concurrent sessions (from ~120 TPS to ~240 TPS) without impacting tail latency.

Those numbers are in the attached Acme_POC_Metrics_Summary.pdf and the cost/latency chart. The results were great to see and the engineering team at Acme did a terrific job on the integration.

If you’re comfortable, we’d love to capture two things for our docs and a short case study:
1) A 1–2 sentence quote we can publish about impact (e.g. “Redwood helped us reduce inference cost and improve UX latency”), and
2) A 15-minute call (recording optional) to let us ask a couple of clarifying questions and confirm attribution and metrics.

Proposed times: Tue 5/18 at 10:00am PT or Wed 5/19 at 9:00am PT. If those don’t work, share a slot that’s easier and we’ll adapt.

I’m copying Laura from our marketing team to fast-track the draft quote and Ben who will follow up on any procurement/logistics items.

Thanks again — excited to put this in front of some of our prospects.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
